description: Furrow compiles published agricultural-land prices for 37 countries and converts them to euros per hectare. Edition 2026.2 preserves each source value, original currency and unit, reporting year, measurement basis and source alongside the converted figure. The archived release uses European Central Bank reference rates for 28 August 2026 and was published on 31 August. Source vintages vary, with examples dating to 2018 or 2020, so this is a mixed-year country comparison, not a harmonised time series. A frozen CSV and README are freely available on Zenodo; the live GitHub edition also offers JSON. CC BY 4.0 covers the compilation, while underlying figures retain their publishers’ terms. A limitation is substantial variation in land definitions: some values include buildings, some describe arable or pastoral land, and several countries use an unweighted median of regions. Currency movements can alter ranks without land-price changes. Simulation uses include coarse land-cost sensitivity scenarios with explicit basis checks. It complements data-eurostat-ifsgrid-agricultural-census-grid, which describes agricultural distribution, not these prices. No country rows were downloaded or recalculated, and the index does not appraise individual parcels.
